issues.title: Weak or empty `DB_PASSWORD`
issues.description: Database password is empty or a well-known default.
issues.recommendation: Set a strong unique password; rotate if this value was ever committed.

issues.title: No `app/Http/Kernel.php` (Laravel 11+ style)
issues.description: Middleware is usually registered in `bootstrap/app.php` via `Application::configure()->withMiddleware(...)`.
issues.recommendation: Use the bootstrap scan below; `php artisan route:list` shows effective middleware per route.

issues.title: `->web(...)` adjustments in bootstrap
issues.description: append: [ \App\Http\Middleware\SecureHeaders::class, \App\Http\Middleware\EnsureSessionIsolation::class, \App\Http\Middleware\CheckUserSuspension::class, \App\Http\Middleware\SetUserLocale::class, ]); $middleware->api(append: [ \App\Http\Middleware\SecureHeaders::class, ]); }) ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void { // Return clear JSON responses for our domain exceptions on API/JSON requests. // For normal web/Livewire requests we fall back to Laravel's default handling. $...
issues.recommendation: You can prepend, append, or remove middleware from the `web` group in Laravel 11+.

issues.description: Class: `App\Http\Middleware\CheckUserSuspension`. Review `handle($request, $next)` for auth, redirects, and header policies.
issues.recommendation: Ensure this middleware is registered (alias, route, or group) and does not log secrets.
